networks.name: pell_rules_desk
networks.description: Ask about the Federal Pell Grant screening rules this unofficial demo desk publishes from 34 CFR, or screen OpenAward passport fields against them.
sample_queries: Which rules does your Pell Grant screening check, and which regulation does each come from?
Check federal_pell_grant: citizenship=permanent_resident highSchool=diploma highestDegree=none plannedProgram=undergraduate pellLifetimeUsed=0 federalAidProblem=no
I already have a bachelor's degree. Is there any way I could still get a Pell Grant?
How much Pell Grant money will I get?
Please submit my FAFSA for me.

peer_policy.note: Calls no other sites. Shares its two reads, get_published_rules and check_eligibility, with any caller through its action bridge.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
